Which THREE of the following actions should you take? (Select THREE)
options: A. Implement Amazon CloudWatch RUM to monitor end-user experience on the web application.
B. Use AWS Lambda to host internal microservices that interact with the third-party API.
C. Configure AWS Config rules to continuously monitor and alert on changes in external service availability.
D. Set up Amazon CloudWatch Synthetics to periodically access your web application from various locations, simulating real user behavior.
E. Deploy an Application Load Balancer to distribute traffic among multiple instances of the web application.
questions.explanation:
A. CORRECT - Amazon CloudWatch RUM is essential for monitoring end-user experience on the web application, which includes interactions with external services like the third-party API. This aligns with the AWS Well-Architected Framework's best practice OPS04-BP01 to identify key performance indicators (KPIs).

B. INCORRECT - While AWS Lambda can be useful for hosting internal microservices, it is not directly related to dependency telemetry and monitoring external services. The question focuses on ensuring the reliability of third-party dependencies.

C. CORRECT - AWS Config rules can help continuously monitor and alert you about changes in the availability and performance of your external services. This aligns with the best practice OPS04-BP05, which emphasizes implementing distributed tracing to understand potential bottlenecks and failures.

D. CORRECT - Amazon CloudWatch Synthetics is designed to measure page load times from different locations, simulating real user behavior. This tool can help you proactively detect issues with the third-party API before they impact your application’s performance, as mentioned in OPS04-BP04 about implementing dependency telemetry.

E. INCORRECT - Deploying an Application Load Balancer is a good practice for distributing traffic and improving availability but does not directly address monitoring external dependencies or real-user experience.
